West Nottawasaga Cemetery Memorial

Date
Sun, Sep 13 2026, 3 - 4pm

The West Nottawasaga Cemetery Memorial Committee is holding a memorial celebration at the cemetery site for anyone from the public to attend. 

If raining, the Memorial will be held on the same date/time at the Emmanuel Presbyterian Church located at 3521 County Road 124. 

Address
7993 33/34 Sideroad Nottawasaga, Nottawa
Location name
West Nottawasaga Cemetery
